posts.text: OpenAI's new budget model meets its own top 'Critical' hacking-risk level, and it's on sale to subscribers. OpenAI says GPT-6.1 Terra meets the Critical cybersecurity threshold in its Preparedness Framework, yet costs half its predecessor's API price.

posts.text: America's cyber agency has formally listed two of the PHP flaws as exploited in real attacks; federal agencies must fix them by Oct 29. It has not said who was hit, and no victim is confirmed by name.
